reason_for_revision: The historical preregistration used symbolic reference_iRecall/reference_recall bands. A fresh 2026 literature audit shows that treating the original InstructScene headline iRecall as an unambiguous end-to-end reference is unsafe because a later independent reproduction reports a large graph-stage versus final-layout discrepancy.

geoscenegraph_2026_instructscene_reprodu.authors_interpretation: The reproduced paper explicitly reports a discrepancy and states that the larger InstructScene number appears to correspond to the first-stage semantic graph rather than the final layout.
